description: Create a shared BullMQ-based background job infrastructure within the Formbricks monorepo to enable reliable, scalable background processing. This foundation should integrate with the existing Next.js application startup process and prepare for future migration of pipeline operations while maintaining current API functionality.
functional_requirements: Create a shared jobs package with clear separation of concerns including connection management, queue operations, worker runtime, and job definitions
Implement in-process BullMQ worker startup that integrates with Next.js application initialization using instrumentation hooks
Define structured job contracts and schemas that can support future migration of existing pipeline logic while keeping current API endpoints unchanged
Add environment-driven configuration for worker tuning and implement comprehensive logging for runtime operations and error handling
Ensure compatibility with existing Redis/Valkey setup and update self-hosting documentation accordingly
Include test coverage for queue setup, worker startup, job scheduling, and processor execution
